plainText:
The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the eighth season of , Pokémon: Advanced Battle, in and ( ).

==Single releases==
The Advanced Battle single DVD releases were released by VIZ Media in 2006 and 2007, containing the entire season between them. Each volume contains five episodes each with the exception of volumes 9 and 10, which contain six episodes each. Optional English closed captioning is included on the DVDs.

 

==The Complete Collection==
 
Pokémon: Advanced Battle - The Complete Collection was released on June 12, 2018 by VIZ Media and distributed through . This Complete Collection contains six discs with 52 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is 3000077895. It consists of a single DVD case in a slip cover.
